blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former Sen. Bong Revilla said an examination of the evidence against him presented by special prosecutors before the Sandiganbayan calls for his acquittal in the malversation case. He made this argument in his 24-page demurrer to evidence, attached to a motion for leave filed before the anti-graft court on Monday. The document was furnished to the media on Wednesday. An accused files a demurrer to evidence to seek the dismissal of a case on the ground that the prosecution failed to present sufficient evidence.
